notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/liuskywalkerjskd__mujoco_iiwa7_r800 --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run; no human reviewed or tested anything. No deviation from the card: the family-config decision and the MujocoDriver helper express the model. The card lists no entry_symbols, so there was no symbol to verify; the card's three model files exist in the clone at the pinned commit. The package serves the card's first model, iiwa7_mjcf/iiwa7_tuned.xml (models[0]), as a simulated R0 world.sim: the step action is data.ctrl, bounded per actuator by the model's actuator_ctrlrange (seven joint targets), and cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults. The other two card models, iiwa7_with_gripper.xml (arm plus gripper, eight actuators) and robotiq_2f85.xml (standalone gripper), are not served; changing model_path and the facts serves another one. MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so the fake backend (fake.py) is a stand-in mujoco module: it parses the MJCF for the joint/actuator shape and control ranges but integrates a placeholder first-order motion and resolves no mesh, contact, equality, inertia, damping, armature, PD gain or forcerange; it was never compared with the real engine. The real-mujoco path (a backend name that backends does not list) was not run. NOT COVERED: the gripper channel and the composite/standalone gripper models, MuJoCo's physics, rendering and any hardware validation. Expected warnings: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the MuJoCo family treats a non-string fake backend entry as the upstream simulator, so native calls are not recorded and G7 has no fake surface to check; this package's entry is a stand-in module, not the upstream simulator); G8.NO_UNIT x3 (the bridge-derived ticks, action.ctrl and reset seed). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. No operator-required limits, so no site-limits.example.json is needed. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
